rationale: C23 plausibly supplied a material loyalty-review template. It combines investigation, review, determination, appeal to the Loyalty Review Board, and the exact substantive standard later used in the child's Part II. The child adapts that machinery from federal employment to United States citizens employed or considered for employment by international organizations, adding preliminary and full-field investigative stages and transmission of advisory determinations to the Secretary General. C12 supplies the exact standard but not the broader procedure; C11 supplies closely related machinery but uses the superseded formulation of the standard.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The standard ... shall be whether or not on all the evidence there is a reasonable doubt as to the loyalty of the person involved to the Government of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: If the Administrator finds ... that, on all the evidence, there is a reasonable doubt as to the loyalty of the officer involved to the Government of the United States

shared_material.child_excerpt: there shall be made available ... the procedures of the Civil Service Regional Loyalty Board (including the opportunity of a hearing) and the right of appeal to the Commission's Loyalty Review Board
shared_material.parent_excerpt: investigation, review, and determination ... including those relating to the right of appeal to the Loyalty Review Board for an advisory recommendation
shared_material.explanation: The later directive reuses the investigation-review-appeal machinery and adapts it to international-organization personnel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Regional Loyalty Board, or the Loyalty Review Board on appeal, shall transmit its determinations ... to the Secretary of State for transmission to the Secretary General
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the right of appeal to the Loyalty Review Board for an advisory recommendation
shared_material.explanation: Both employ an advisory loyalty-board determination routed to the official responsible for the ultimate personnel consequence.
